title: Ankhorage Hetzner Infrastructure
summary: Provides a Hetzner Cloud compute adapter with REST-backed lifecycle operations and shell-free SSH host verification.
purpose: Translate provider-neutral compute intent into Hetzner Cloud server lifecycle behavior without leaking provider credentials into portable state.
responsibilities: Provision and manage Hetzner Cloud compute instances through the authenticated Cloud API.
Verify host reachability through a shell-free, host-key-aware SSH probe.
Map Hetzner lifecycle state and failures into provider-neutral compute results.
boundaries: Does not define provider-neutral infrastructure contracts.
Does not deploy application workloads after compute provisioning.
Does not persist provider API tokens or SSH credentials in portable infrastructure state.
audience: Infrastructure hosts selecting Hetzner Cloud as a compute provider.
Operators provisioning provider-neutral compute targets on Hetzner.
useCases: Provision a Hetzner Cloud server through the common compute adapter.
Inspect, suspend, resume, or delete an existing Hetzner server.
Verify SSH reachability without shell interpolation.

architecture.role: A cloud compute adapter translating Infra compute operations to Hetzner Cloud and SSH boundaries.
invariants: Provider API and SSH credentials remain transient execution inputs.
SSH probing is shell-free and validates host identity.
Public results conform to the provider-neutral compute contract.

configuration: Hetzner API authentication and SSH verification inputs are required for applicable operations.
security: Provider and SSH credentials remain transient, and SSH probes avoid shell execution.
limitations: Workload deployment is owned by separate runtime adapters.
